description: The executable MVP (python -m iap.mvp): one complete, deterministic, fully traced institutional trading loop on a single synthetic equity - seeded market data -> per-venue books + consolidated book -> feature engine -> three fitted linear_z_v1 alphas ensembled -> single-stock mean-variance portfolio target -> hard risk per child -> TWAP / POV / IS child scheduling -> SOR over three venues -> execution simulator -> TCA -> attribution -> DecisionTrace (JSONL + SQLite) -> report. Every value here is validated fail-fast by iap.mvp.config (file and key named in the error). Money is in the reporting currency of configs/risk/risk.json (USD); prices are integer ticks; every duration is event-time nanoseconds; no wall clock anywhere on the path.
notes: alphas: EQ01 (microprice), EQ03 (multi-level OFI) and EQ06 (short-horizon momentum) are three of the six golden production alphas of API_ALPHA.md; all three carry fitted, non-dead linear_z_v1 parameters in configs/strategies/alpha_params.json (feature_version-checked on load), so no substitution was needed.

horizon: the alphas read their pinned features but the MVP acts on a 1 s holding horizon; EQ03 (pinned 5 s) and EQ06 (pinned 10 s) enter the ensemble as z-scores (iap.backtest.engine.ensemble_scores: equal-weight z average rescaled by the mean |beta|), so the mixture is scale-free; the research runner measured EQ03@1s IC +0.018 and EQ06@1s IC +0.016 (research/experiments).

portfolio.tc_bps (0.001 bp): the optimizer's linear transaction-cost penalty is deliberately orders of magnitude BELOW the modelled round-trip cost (half-spread + fee + impact, about 1 bp on a USD 190 stock) - the fitted expected returns are 0.001-0.05 bp per decision, so with the honest cost the mean-variance solve would never trade and the execution / TCA / trace path would stay unexercised. It acts as a dead-band on negligible expected returns. The report measures the real cost through TCA and states the net result; it never assumes the optimizer's number.

portfolio.conf_min (0.1): below it the optimizer sees a zero expected return and flattens (the Java paper vertical's rule); urgency = ensemble confidence selects the algo: TWAP (passive limit at the same-side best) up to 0.2, POV up to 0.35, IS above.

portfolio.min_bars: the EWMA variance needs completed 1-minute bars; until min_bars bar returns exist a decision produces no target (counted as decisions_without_covariance) instead of a fabricated prior - the first three minutes of the session are warm-up.

execution controls (max_child_qty, max_participation, min_slice_interval_ns, latency_budget_ns) are read from configs/execution/execution.json defaults; the sor block must equal its sor block (checked) and every document is hashed into config_version.

session: 15 minutes of event time (about 16k events on three venues) keeps the golden run under the 20 s budget; the generator's self-exciting flow consumes its slots in roughly the first 60% of the window (its pinned rate rule), the close auction prints at 13:45; the halt lands at 30% of the session (13:34:30 for 45 s).
